run_image2text_lora_finetune: run LoRA fine-tuning for image-to-text vision-language models on Intel Gaudi accelerators using Optimum Habana
eval_image2text_model: evaluate a fine-tuned image-to-text model on a test dataset using average normalized Levenshtein similarity
create_llava_data_collator: create a data collator for LLaVA models that handles image and text batching with proper token masking
